decision: Adopt a provider-side frozen binding contract (declarative + sha256 pin + introspective verifier + behavioural probes) as the mechanism TensorDEM offers to cross-repo library binders.
alternatives: A: keep prose-only assumptions and per-consumer smoke tests (status quo)
B: presence-only inventory of public names (lightweight baseline)
C: declarative contract + fingerprint + signature/negative-assertion checks + behavioural probes (this mission)
hypothesis: H1: the contract detector classifies all 7 real drift classes, and the binding semantics (instantaneous non-accumulated loads, native clock, restart) satisfy analytic identities to machine precision. H0 (rejected): binders that accumulate loads would reproduce the same impulse (they would give (n+1)/2 times the exact impulse).
metrics: drift detection rate over 7 controlled mutation classes
impulse-momentum relative error vs analytic n*dt*F (2-D and 3-D)
internal ledger vs analytic impulse relative error
native clock vs n*dt relative error
restart round-trip and continuation max position drift (m)
baseline_control: presence-only inventory check (names exist) fed with the same 7 mutants
stopping_rule: Stop after one scripted run of scripts/xval_library_binding_contract.py; no threshold tuning after inspecting results. If any metric misses its predeclared threshold, report honest-FAIL with the failing stage and do not re-run with relaxed thresholds.
exclusions: Physics-accuracy validation of DEM contact laws is out of scope for this anchor; only the binding surface (clock, shapes, units, load semantics, restart entry points) is frozen and probed.
confounders: fixed particles hand momentum to supports
contact damping and linear drag dissipate momentum
indenter contact can be the dominant force
2-D and 3-D surfaces differ in load_time and restart naming
controls: isolated probe samples: no supports, no dashpot, no drag, indenter held off (tool_gap=10 m)
repitition_rationale: The probed identities are algebraic, so error is dominated by floating-point rounding, not sampling; sweep n_steps in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128} to show the error does not grow with step count. Mutation detection is exhaustive over the 7 declared drift classes (no sampling).

environment.resource_limits: single core CPU, <2 s wall per run, no cluster use

analysis_plan: Aggregate per-metric max relative error; compare detection rate against the presence-only baseline; classify each mutation finding by severity; report every miss as a limitation.
